newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Daewoo sees higher 1997/98 sales.
newsitem.headline: India's Daewoo sees higher 1997/98 sales.

text.p: Daewoo Motors India, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Corp, said on Wednesday that it expects turnover to rise to 15 billion rupees ($420 million) in 1997/98 (April-March) from 9.4 billion in the previous fiscal year.

"Our turnover should cross 15 billion rupees this year. Car output will increase to 25,000, and we will start producing 300,000 engines and gear boxes, most of which will be exported," Daewoo Motors managing director S.G. Awasthi told Reuters in an interview.
Awasthi declined to forecast net profit for 1997/98. Daewoo Motors' net profit plunged to 10.8 million rupees in 1996/97 from 496.9 million rupees in 1995/96.
